image_description: A side-profile view of a rabbit sitting in green grass. The rabbit has brown and grey mottled fur, long upright ears, and is facing left. Its hind legs are tucked beneath its body, and the forelegs are partially visible but obscured by the grass and body angle. The tail is short and fluffy, visible at the rear.
